title: IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.36860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. translated_title: IronLLM：锻造面向实时具身智能的紧凑型边缘原生语言模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了IronLLM-0.6B，一个专为高效端侧推理设计的654M参数语言模型。IronLLM-0.6B将混合注意力架构与X-MTP相结合，后者是一种轻量级的共享KV多词元预测设计，消除了逐层KV缓存重放，并采用轻量级验证头实现无需回滚的草稿生成，从而实现1.48倍的解码加速。该模型基于以质量为导向的数据流水线，在约6.2万亿词元上进行预训练，并通过多领域同策略蒸馏进行后训练，以整合来自领域专家教师模型的能力。为了更好地满足端侧场景的低延迟要求，IronLLM-0.6B采用了仅指令设计。评估结果显示，IronLLM-0.6B相比Qwen3.5-0.8B和MiniCPM5-1B等更大的模型取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时在许多任务上生成更为简洁的回复。我们进一步提出了IronLLM-0.6B-Light，它取代了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: IronLLM-0.6B是一个654M参数的边缘原生语言模型，通过混合注意力架构与轻量级共享KV多词元预测设计X-MTP实现1.48倍解码加速，并结合多领域同策略蒸馏后训练，以更小参数量和更简洁的回复达到与更大模型相当的竞争力，满足实时具身智能的端侧低延迟需求。
en_tdlr: IronLLM-0.6B is a 654M-parameter edge-native language model that achieves a 1.48x decoding speedup via a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design, and is post-trained with multi-domain on-policy distillation, delivering competitive performance against larger models like Qwen3.5-0.8B with more concise responses for real-time on-device embodied intelligence.
